description: Source code for a web configuration client that uses libparodus for messaging, handles connection setup, message reception, and URL configuration, with functions for thread management and message processing.

methods.name: initWebConfigClient
methods.description: Initializes the web configuration client by connecting to parodus and starting message reception thread.

methods.name: get_webcfg_instance
methods.description: Returns the current web configuration libparodus instance.

methods.name: get_global_client_threadid
methods.description: Returns the thread ID of the client thread handling message reception.
